about: A profile is a named set of cases an implementation can claim: 'passes every active MUST assertion in profile P'. This file is generated by scripts/regenerate from scenarios/cesr/ and must not be edited. Fields: name; normative (true when every assertion cites a specification clause); spec (the pinned specification the assertions cite); cases (the case ids, in order). Disputed and deprecated cases are listed but excluded from conformance results by their status.
name: cesr-1.0
